Brutalist (Pelican theme)

A static-site theme that applies Copeland’s brutalist guidelines: readable, accessible, fast, underlined links.

Source
GitHub: mc-buckets/brutalist
Creator
mc-buckets (GitHub user)
Made
2018
Style
Brutalist web design (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Plain, utilitarian
Evidence
Read the README and static/css/main.css on GitHub on 2026-10-02. Repository created 28 August 2018 (GitHub API). The README cover image shows only the theme name and the Pelican logo, so it is not evidence of the look. The demo site was not captured.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

README: “After reading David Bryant Copeland’s Brutalist Web Design a few weeks ago, I was inspired to try and apply those design principles to a Pelican theme.” Its stated features include “Clean, readable, accessible, and fast” and “W3C validated”.

main.css sets font-family: "Lato", sans-serif on the body and underlined links in #232a2e, with #39739d on hover.

No license file is reported by the GitHub API.

Why it belongs

Evidence that the guidelines travel without the default look. A capture would show whether the result still reads as Brutalist web design.
